en: Introducing expansion parts that can be jointed to the MS body (sold separately) to reproduce the enhanced Double Zeta Gundam!
*The MS body is not included with this product.
● Includes a set of various parts to reproduce the enhanced Double Zeta Gundam.
● Reproduced in molding color that conforms to the MS body sold in stores.
● Includes newly designed “Ver.Ka” marking (water transfer type) to reproduce the enhanced Double Zeta Gundam.
<Set contents>
Complete set of various parts for reproducing Enhanced Double Zeta Gundam / “Ver.Ka” water transfer decal
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS
・No adhesive is used in the assembly.
This product is a set of parts to expand on the "MG 1/100 Enhanced Gundam Ver.Ka" (sold separately), which is currently being released at stores nationwide, and reproduce the "enhanced type".
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the posted photo, you will need this product and the pre-assembly "MG 1/100 Double Zeta Gundam Ver.Ka" (sold separately).
(After assembly, it cannot be converted to enhanced Double Zeta Gundam.)
* Also, "MG 1/100 Double Zeta GundamVer.Ka" (sold separately) is available for sale at Premium Bandai.
None.
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
